mechanism: Voriconazole may inhibit CYP2C9-mediated metabolism of chlorthalidone and both drugs can cause hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, increasing QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, monitor ECG for QT prolongation, and consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate supplementation of potassium and magnesium.
